cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Let Them Keep Hope
cards.instruction: Hide discouraging information because you believe hope is the only thing keeping someone able to continue.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Keep the seed packets. The allotment letter says we're on the waiting list. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You've covered our number. If it's another year indoors, I'm giving up gardening.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. The important bit is we're on it. Let's start tomatoes on my windowsill.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You'll get tired of them before we get a plot.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Take my sunny room. I'll move the bed; keep the packets.

mechanism: A directs starting plants while concealing the discouraging queue position, yielding personal space so B continues gardening.
confusable: Unlike merely solving lack of land, A hides information because B would quit; borrowed authority offers concrete concessions to keep the plan alive.
comparison: A home-space sacrifice for shared gardening differs from shielding an artist from rejection correspondence.
seedUse: D111-b covered queue number and sunny-room offer; S02-b adjusts the plan after B predicts cooperation will fail.
